title: Code and data for: Every Single-Centred Black Hole Index of the Z2 CHL Model Is Positive
description: LaTeX source, PDF, exact-arithmetic orbit computation, ball-arithmetic certificates and independent checks of the level-two Rademacher expansion for the paper proving Sen's positivity conjecture for every single-centred black hole index of the Z2 CHL model.
